# shadcn/ui Item

Source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/e31626978fe8e3804fe2e792e11e32dc560e40a8/apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/item.tsx

MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn. Original reviewed source and license are retained here.

The software directory adapts Item's media / content / description / footer composition into the existing native-link TypeScript renderer. Local theme tokens, original covers, compact two-column layout and existing page-card interactions are host adaptations. React, Radix, Tailwind and class-variance-authority are not added to the runtime. The upstream focus ring is replaced by the host's single-border focus treatment. No upstream code is executed or bundled from this directory.
